title.narrative: Capacity Development for Sustainable Plant GeneticResources Utilization & Conservation in Eastern Africa 2011-2013 (EAPGREN/ASARECA Bridging Phase)
Capacity Development for Sustainable Plant GeneticResources Utilization & Conservation in Eastern Africa 2011-2013 (EAPGREN/ASARECA Bridging Phase)

description.narrative: Stöd till " Association for Strengthening Agricultural Research in Eastern and Central Africa (ASARECA)" för "Eastern Africa Plant Genetic Resources Network (EAPGREN)" EAPGREN är ett regionalt genbank nätverk mellan medverkande länders National Agricultural Research Systems (NARS). Målet med projektet är att bidra till ekonomisk utveckling och ökade försörjningsmöjligheter för östafrikas befolknin

Support to ASARECA for EAPGREN, a regional gene bank network among ASARECA's member states NARs. The goal of the project is to enhance economic growth and improve livelihoods of eastern African community while enhancing the quality of environment. Its purpose is to promote sustainable use and conservation of PGR in the sub-region.
